MWI.note: Nothing on rules or authority against AI harms.

facts.fact: UniPod Malawi says government ministries submitted 18 AI use cases, five were shortlisted by a multi-stakeholder panel and published as challenges, and recent-graduate teams will work with ministry focal points and mentors to develop, test and present AI solutions.

MWI.note: Page is undated; the year is a proxy.
The shortlisted use cases are not named by sector and no tool is built or in service.
A challenge for teams; no AI model, dataset or computing is stated as built.
A challenge on AI use cases is not a consultation on a named digital law or policy.
